answer: Miscellaneous >> History & Biography Question ID: 37346 Country: India Title: In which year Muhammad (SAW) died and in which year Imam Abu Hanifa (RA) was born Question: In which year Muhammad (SAW) died and in which year Imam Abu Hanifa (RA) was born? Answer ID: 37346 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 511/511/M=1433) The holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) left for his heavenly abode in 11 Hijri, and Imam Abu Hanifa (رحمة الله عليه) was born in 80 Hijri. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
